en-US.title: 333 Lives
en-US.subtitle: Live intentionally. Every day.
en-US.description:
333 Lives is your all-in-one personal life companion — built to help you live with intention, capture your story, and stay close to the people who matter most.

YOUR DAILY 3 INTENTIONS
Start every day with focus. Set 3 intentions that matter to you — not a to-do list, but a compass. Track how often you show up for yourself, build momentum, and reflect on your growth week by week.

HABIT TRACKING THAT STICKS
Build the habits that define the life you want. Each habit card shows your 7-day check-in history with mood colors — gold for great days, sage for okay, red for hard ones. Watch your streaks grow and never lose sight of how far you've come.

YOUR LIFE STORY, BEAUTIFULLY CAPTURED
The Life Timeline lets you record milestones and moments — big and small — with photos and notes. First job, first home, a conversation that changed everything. Your story deserves to be told.

MEMORIES & VAULT
Organize photos and memories by collection. Store your most private thoughts and keepsakes in a secure Vault. Everything you've lived, organized in one place.

DAILY REFLECTION
A built-in gratitude journal, mood tracking, and end-of-day reflections help you close each day with clarity. The annual review gives you a bird's-eye view of your whole year.

PULSE — PRIVATE CIRCLE
Share moments with the people in your Circle through a private feed. React and stay present in each other's lives, no matter the distance.

FAMILY TREE
Build and explore your family tree. Add members, relationships, and photos to preserve your family history for generations.

LEGACY LETTERS & FUTURE MESSAGES
Write letters for loved ones, keep them sealed until you are ready to share, or create future messages that unlock on a date you choose.

TASKS & LIFE PLANNING
Manage personal tasks with priorities and due dates. Track upcoming birthdays and anniversaries so the important dates stay visible when you plan your days.

333 Lives is designed for anyone who wants to be intentional about how they live, grow, and connect. Dark, focused, and distraction-free — so you can go deeper, not just faster.

Download 333 Lives and start living on purpose.
